name: Sheet-Pan Turkey Meatloaf with Roasted Broccoli and Potatoes

components.name: Turkey Mini Meatloaves
steps: In a mixing bowl combine ground turkey, oats, minced onion, egg, thyme, Worcestershire, salt and most of ketchup without compacting the mixture.
Shape into four thick mini loaves, brush remaining ketchup over the top and arrange on a separate lined tray.
Roast turkey and broccoli about 25-30 minutes, checking turkey reaches 74 C, while potatoes finish until browned and tender.
Cool and portion one meatloaf, roasted broccoli and potatoes per container. Leave lids ajar only while rapidly chilling and then seal.

components.name: Roasted Potatoes & Broccoli

ingredients.name: Raw potatoes, diced into 2 cm pieces

steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Toss diced potatoes with half the olive oil and season, and roast alone for 10-15 minutes first.
Toss broccoli with the remaining oil and paprika; arrange around meatloaves without overcrowding.
